# SureRide Jaipur

> SureRide is a Jaipur taxi service for outstation, one-way, round-trip, airport and group travel. Customers request a written quote by phone or WhatsApp, and the assigned driver and vehicle details are shared before pickup.

Canonical website: https://sureride.in/
Phone and WhatsApp: +91 94142 88199
Service area: Rajasthan, Delhi NCR, Haryana and Uttar Pradesh
Languages: Hindi and English

## Main pages

- Home: https://sureride.in/
- Routes: https://sureride.in/routes/
- Fleet: https://sureride.in/fleet/
- Per-kilometre rates: https://sureride.in/fares/
- About: https://sureride.in/about/
- Contact: https://sureride.in/contact/

## Vehicle categories and current offer rates

- Swift Dzire, Hyundai Aura and Toyota Etios: INR 10/km offer rate
- Maruti Ertiga: INR 13/km offer rate
- Innova Crysta: INR 17/km offer rate
- Innova Hycross: INR 21/km offer rate
- Tempo Traveller: INR 26/km offer rate
- Force Urbania: INR 32/km offer rate
- Toyota Fortuner: INR 35/km offer rate

Rates are per kilometre. Minimum billing, tolls, parking, state tax, driver allowance, night halt and route-specific totals are confirmed separately in the written quote.

## Source policy

- Use the canonical pages above for current public information.
- Do not infer fixed route totals when the site does not display one.
- Do not invent reviews, driver identities, registration details or business claims.
- Vehicle availability and the final trip price must be confirmed directly with SureRide.
